metadata.note: Verified baseline with Cyberleek claim attributed to VGC and PC Gamer. Automated updates mark indexed coverage and social posts as unverified until manually checked.

articles.title: Leonida's recompilation project: shaders translated, GTA VI still does not boot
articles.summary: The developers report translating 26,503 Xbox RDNA2 shaders. Their README explicitly states the game does not boot yet. A shader milestone is not a playable PC port.
articles.why_it_matters: The key milestone is booting actual GTA VI code, not just translating shaders. A developer repository can be active long before the game runs.
articles.verification: Developer self-report, not independent gameplay verification
articles.description: Leonida claims all 26,503 RDNA2 shaders translated but says GTA VI does not boot yet.

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album is now available
articles.summary: Rockstar announced the official GTA VI soundtrack album, released alongside the console launch week.
articles.why_it_matters: This is an official game release-week update, but it doesn't announce anything about the PC port.

articles.title: Bitdefender investigates fake GTA VI PC streaming client distributing malware
articles.summary: Security researchers documented a fake PC streaming client that uses a ClickFix-style attack. Do not treat PC client installers as evidence of an unofficial port.
articles.why_it_matters: There is no verified PC client to install. Third-party installers should not be confused with a playable game.
articles.verification: Independent coverage; check the original report

articles.title: Cyberleek claims a GTA VI Xbox build leaked without its executable
articles.summary: VGC reported that Cyberleek claimed to distribute a November 2026 Xbox development build, with the main executable withheld. Screenshots and the group's own statements do not independently establish that the archive is genuine.
articles.why_it_matters: Without the executable, nobody can demonstrate that the alleged files boot. Even an authentic Xbox executable would still require major translation or emulation work on PC.
articles.verification: Reported claim, not independently verified; no proven playable build

articles.title: Cyberleek ties a promised missing GTA VI executable to a crypto target
articles.summary: According to PC Gamer, Cyberleek claimed the missing Xbox executable would come on November 23 regardless, or earlier if a crypto token reached a $15 million market value. The outlet said the alleged build had not been authenticated.
articles.why_it_matters: This is a future promise, not evidence of a file or a working port. The cryptocurrency condition is an additional reason to treat links and related claims cautiously.
articles.verification: Second-hand report of Cyberleek statement; promised event unverified

articles.title: GTA VI officially launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S
articles.summary: Take-Two confirms that Grand Theft Auto VI is available on current-generation PlayStation and Xbox consoles. No PC launch was part of this release announcement.
articles.why_it_matters: The console launch is confirmed. PC is a separate milestone, not an implied part of this launch.

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Now Available: Rockstar's launch announcement
articles.summary: Rockstar's official launch post introduces GTA VI's release-day features and the state of Leonida.
articles.why_it_matters: The best way to confirm Rockstar announcements is to read the publisher's original post.

articles.title: No verified GTA VI gameplay through PS5 emulation or an unofficial PC port
articles.summary: A November 18 assessment says current PS5 emulation does not provide a playable GTA VI PC experience. This is independent reporting, not an official Rockstar statement.
articles.why_it_matters: Emulating basic PS5 software or homebrew is different from running a complex commercial title like GTA VI.
articles.verification: Independent coverage; check the original report

articles.title: Netcraft exposes fake GTA VI cracked builds and misleading PC download sites
articles.summary: Netcraft analyzed phishing and malware lures presented as leaked builds, cracks or PC releases. Evidence of a fake installer is not evidence of a working port.
articles.why_it_matters: A downloadable file marketed as a crack can be a malware lure. This is a security update, not proof a working crack exists.
articles.verification: Independent coverage; check the original report

articles.title: Rockstar releases the Grand Theft Auto VI launch trailer
articles.summary: The official launch trailer is available from Rockstar, with footage and the original soundtrack score.
articles.why_it_matters: This is first-party marketing material, useful for official visuals but unrelated to PC availability.

projects.name: Leonida
projects.description: Static recompilation and translation of GTA VI's Xbox Series edition for Windows, using a user's own readable game package. Tracks shader translation and system runtime work.
projects.status: GTA VI does not boot (per README)

projects.name: ScarlettX
projects.description: Experimental high-level emulator for Xbox Series x86-64 games. Project-wide test coverage is not equivalent to GTA VI compatibility.

projects.name: AnyPS5
projects.description: Native executable relinker and PS5 library reimplementation. The authors describe it as a relinker, not a conventional emulator.

projects.name: Kyty
projects.description: Early-stage PS4/PS5 emulator. Its published README describes support for some simple PS4 games and PS5 homebrew, not commercial GTA VI.

projects.name: RPCSX
projects.description: Experimental PS4 and PS5 emulator. Its development is important to console research, but it has not independently demonstrated GTA VI gameplay.

projects.name: Xbox2Windows
projects.description: Research into static recompilation and graphics translation from Xbox Series to Windows. The project's public code and test samples are not proof of a GTA VI boot.

projects.name: GTAVI-Recomp
projects.description: Prototype PS5 system-library translation research explicitly targeting GTA VI. No verified playable GTA VI build or end-to-end boot.

projects.name: PortPS5
projects.description: PS5 binary relinking and replacement system libraries. Automated reference tests and opcode coverage do not mean GTA VI is compatible.
